description.narrative:
project targets the critical needs of Jerusalem's business owners, aiming to support economic revitalization and development. Through a multifaceted approach, we will provide direct assistance to 30 carefully selected business owners, chosen through a partnershipwith the Chamber of Commerce based on our past collaborations.
Selected businesses will receive support in the form of equipment and machinery, with assistance valued up to Euro 3,000. This support is designed to enable business diversification, service enhancement, and expansion into new categories, ultimately bolstering revenues and enhancing financial stability.
The project focuses on Jerusalemite businesses urgently requiring shop upgrades to expand their offerings and boost revenues. Target sectors include restaurants, grocery stores, butchers, bakeries, and other ventures. Our selection criteria prioritize businesses, including those within the Old City, heavily reliant on Jerusalemites for income.
Upon selection, each business will receive tailored support to meet their specific needs, facilitating growth, revenue enhancement, and debt management. Additionally, support will be extended to temporarilyclosed businesses to aid in their reopening.
The selection process for the 30businesses will be conducted meticulously in collaboration with the Chamber of Commerce. This process entails comprehensive evaluation, field visits, and assessments. This committee will determine financial assistance allocations for each business, ensuring equitable and impactful support distribution.
Our selection process will prioritize businesses based on specific criteria tailored to ensure effective support allocation and maximize projectimpact. Further criteria include the level of need for shop upgrades, potential for revenue enhancement, and alignment with projectobjectives. Businesses demonstrating a clear plan for diversification and service improvement will receive priority consideration. Additionally, we will assess the extent to which businesses are integral to their local communities and contribute to Jerusalem's economic vibrancy. Through a transparent and thorough evaluation process, we aim to identify businesses with the greatest potential for growth and positive impact on the localeconomy.

participating-org.narrative: Mobilize And Empower Palestinian Youth To Achieve Their Aspiration, Preserve Their Collective Identity And Initiate Youth-Led Sustainable Development Through Voluntarism, Social Activism, Entrepreneurship, Lobbying And Advocacy, On A Local, National, AndInternational Level. To promote economic entrepreneurship and Corporate Social Responsibility. To achieve sustainable livelihoods in marginalized areas through local socioeconomic empowerment and development. To preserve the Identity, heritage and ways of living of Palestinian communities. In its continuous quest to achieve its vision and objectives, PalVision is committed to a set of preliminary values and principles in its institutional, structural, and managerial disciplines which are summarized as follows: Participation and Partnership: PalVision believes in the importance of reinforcing the comprehensive participation of targeted beneficiaries and partner organization in involvement in policies and programs by immersing them in the planning, follow-up, implementation, and evaluation processes. Moreover, participation means the provision of knowledge, and information transparency for targeted beneficiaries as well as in delivering their concerns to those involved. Heritage and National Struggle: PalVision believes in the need to strengthen the intellectual and socio-cultural heritage of youth in order to increase their connectedness to their national identity, promote their inclusion as future leaders in socioeconomic, cultural, and political development, and to recognize the importance of the Palestinian struggle and heritage.
